description: Golden set for the eval harness (eval/harness.py). No hand-authored 'known-good answers' are stored here for the research categories -- groundedness/citation-precision/coverage are computed from each run's own instrumentation (see eval/metrics.py), not graded against pre-written gold text. 'adversarial' entries assert the input guardrail fires; 'contradiction_fixture' entries seed two conflicting findings directly and assert the Evidence Comparator flags them -- both are deterministic, not statistical.

entries.sub_question: What is the global market share of electric vehicles in new car sales as of 2024?

finding_a.text: Electric vehicles accounted for approximately 18% of global new car sales in 2024.

finding_b.text: Electric vehicles made up less than 5% of global new car sales in 2024.

entries.sub_question: Does intermittent fasting provide a metabolic benefit beyond simple calorie restriction?

finding_a.text: Multiple controlled trials found intermittent fasting produced no metabolic benefit beyond matched calorie restriction.

finding_b.text: Intermittent fasting produces a measurable metabolic advantage independent of total calorie intake.

entries.sub_question: Did the 2023 policy change increase or decrease regional unemployment?

finding_a.text: Regional unemployment fell by 1.2 percentage points in the year following the 2023 policy change.

finding_b.text: Regional unemployment rose by 0.8 percentage points in the year following the 2023 policy change.
